Lil Pump hit 31.6M Spotify monthly listeners in an archived Dec 2018 snapshot. Today it's 5.1M. Where did the 2017-18 SoundCloud rap class actually go? 📼

In 2017-18 the SoundCloud scene produced a run of Spotify superstars: Lil Pump, Trippie Redd, Lil Skies, Ski Mask The Slump God and Lil Xan.

We compared the highest monthly-listener count in readable Wayback Machine snapshots of their Spotify pages with Oct 15, 2026: Lil Xan 9.0M → 1.2M (−87%), Lil Pump 31.6M → 5.1M (−84%), Ski Mask The Slump God 10M → 4.4M (−56%), Lil Skies 10.3M → 4.7M (−54%).

The outlier is Trippie Redd: 20.2M in an archived Jun 2021 snapshot, 25.2M today (+25%), with 19.3B lifetime Spotify streams per kworb. Lil Xan's "Betrayed" alone has 655.2M streams, and Lil Pump's "I Love It" with Kanye West has 781.2M.

Note: archive snapshots are sparse, so real peaks were likely higher than shown.

Who from the SoundCloud era should we look back at next? 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners + Wayback Machine snapshots of Spotify artist pages + kworb Spotify streams · as of Oct 15, 2026

#soundcloudrap #lilpump #trippieredd #lilskies #hiphop
